name: lw_24088
statement: (a b : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) (hb : 1 < b) : (a / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 1) + b / Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 1)) ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt (a * b)) / Real.sqrt (a * b + 1)
closed: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) (hb : 1 < b), (a / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 1) + b / Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 1)) ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt (a * b)) / Real.sqrt (a * b + 1)
